description: Hydrologische Rohdaten (Hochwasserportal NRW) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Landesamt für Natur, Umwelt und Klima Nordrhein-Westfalen. The data available here is unchecked raw data, which can be fraught with errors and data gaps. For this reason, no guarantee can be given for the completeness and correctness of this data. This data is not suitable for simulations, calculations, analyses, etc. and can lead to massive misstatements. Coverage: Landesamt für Natur, Umwelt und Klima Nordrhein-Westfalen. The portal shows the English title as "Raw hydrological data (flood portal NRW)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Landesamt für Natur, Umwelt und Klima Nordrhein-Westfalen. Its keywords include Wasserstände, Kleve-Bimmen, Hochwasser, Fluss, Niederschlag, opendata. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-02-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/zero-2-0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
